svg.title: RBP research platform — implemented architecture
svg.desc: Google Cloud CPU processing and original training share GCS with an initial Modal GPU sweep. Later sweeps use local inputs uploaded to Modal Volume and return scores locally. Local fitting and statistics produce committed evidence; GitHub Actions checks it, and author-published releases are archived by Zenodo.
svg.text: Implemented architecture / batch model training → reproducible evidence
Later sweeps · local inputs, Modal GPU, local outputs
Combine selected original + later evidence with local datasets
Author release after checks — not CI deployment
Scope: submitted RBP study · GCP CPU + Modal GPU · no online inference service
Later sweeps return results locally; they do not write to GCS.
